source.title: 【 AC6 Steam版 】 軽逆でランクマ SEASON17 シングルA～S昇格戦 03【 #259 】
source.platform: Steam (stated in the stream title; not visually verifiable)
source.overlay_family: broadcast layout: game scaled into a sub-rectangle; avatar, comment panel and ticker outside it
source.overlay_status: the game image occupies roughly x 0.009-0.856 W, y 0.028-0.878 H of the video frame (exact rectangle on the 1080p copy: x 16-1648, y 36-954, 1632x918 = 16:9); the avatar, comment panel and ticker lie outside the game rectangle. Not production-equivalent capture: the Tracker captures the game window itself, so this set measures robustness to a rescaled, re-encoded game image

coverage.structure: PARTIAL: 0-4630 s of 17135 s (27 %); inside the window all 463 ten-second contact thumbnails were reviewed and 15 matches delimited from them; 4630-17135 s not reviewed (no claim is made about it)
coverage.interval_ends: 15 of 15 match ends inside the window reviewed as 2 fps band strips cropped from the game rectangle
coverage.status: partial coverage (window only); all 15 window events second-verified on the 1080p60 copy
coverage.verification_method: native 1080p60 (format 299, section 0-4640 s) central-band crop at each banner midpoint: 15/15 legible and matching (AY-07 and AY-13 midpoints fall on dim pulse frames, still legible)
coverage.known_annotation_limits: 2 fps strip labels can lead the shown frame by up to ~0.3 s; bounds are +/-0.5 s
